rule: Width of every box created through manage_diagram; it cannot be changed there
evidence: Probe maps: every box 150 px wide; exemplars use one width per level (120-205 px)

rule: Box height is box_height_base plus resource_row_height for each visible resource
evidence: Probe maps: 100/124/148/172/196 px for 0/1/2/3/4 resources (editor-made exemplar boxes use 80 + 24 per resource)

rule: Height added to a box for each visible resource
evidence: Probe maps and 315 of 345 exemplar boxes

rule: Horizontal space between neighbouring boxes in a row; it must fit the label of the line between them
evidence: Exemplar process maps: median 181 px (middle half 165-196)

rule: Horizontal space between neighbouring boxes in a row on a customer journey
evidence: B2C 140 px; B2B median 186 px

rule: Vertical space from the bottom of the tallest box in a row to the top of the next row; it holds loop-back lines and their labels
evidence: Exemplars: median 140 px (middle half 107-192)

rule: Boxes in a row share their middle (centre line) because every line attaches at the middle of a side; equal middles keep happy-path lines straight
evidence: manage_diagram attaches lines only at side middles

rule: Distance from the top of the canvas to the top of the first row; room for loops over it and for end markers above it
evidence: free_end_length_vertical plus a loop's height

rule: Vertical space between the bottom of one band of rows and the top of the next when a long main path wraps; the wrap line runs back through it
evidence: row_gap plus room for the wrap line

rule: Boxes on one row before the main path wraps to the next row
evidence: Exemplars wrap after 6-7; 6 x 330 px fits the 2000 px canvas of a blank level

rule: Boxes on one level before the rest moves into a drill-down
evidence: Server warning upn_level_too_many_activities; rubric R01; exemplar child levels median 6

rule: Outcomes of one decision box before the skill warns that the decision is worth splitting
evidence: data/line-sides.csv L06: a fourth outcome has to share a side

rule: Length of a start or end line (one end on a box; the other a free end or end marker) leaving or entering a left or right side
evidence: Requested placement; server clear-space routing can change the side or shorten the stub; check returned geometry

rule: Length of a start or end line leaving or entering a top or bottom side
evidence: Three times the server's 40 px; the server still draws 40 px and manage_diagram cannot set it

rule: Space kept clear left of a first box and right of a last box (140 px above or below a box with an early end) so the longer start and end lines fit
evidence: free_end_length plus the 16 px end marker and a small margin

rule: The server wraps every line label at about this many characters and centres it on its line; line breaks sent in a label are not kept
evidence: Probe maps

rule: Longest line label; about five wrapped lines
evidence: Exemplars: median 49-88 characters by map

rule: House label limit for start and end lines whose returned stubs can be short
evidence: Probe maps

rule: Approximate width of one label character; a gap must exceed server_label_wrap times this plus 25 px
evidence: Exemplars: median gap minus 6.2 x longest line = 23 px

rule: Box text is a verb and its object in at most this many words
evidence: Exemplars: median 4 words; 84% have 6 or fewer

rule: Most resources shown on one box; more go into attachments
evidence: Exemplars: typically 2-3; 95% of boxes have 5 or fewer

rule: Xavery's rule (Oct 2026): no box carries more than this many resources, people included, whatever skill draws it; every object left off is still named in the box's note. max_resources_shown stays the default for generated maps and must not exceed it
evidence: Xavery: a box listing every object an automation writes grew past the box below it

rule: Border colour for boxes that are not ordinary steps: continuous management bars; exception handling; set-up boxes
evidence: 9 of 345 exemplar boxes (navy 2 px border on white)

rule: Fill colour for emphasised boxes
evidence: 9 of 345 exemplar boxes

rule: Every journey box lists the Customer resource (Human) first
evidence: 68 of 68 exemplar journey boxes

rule: Width of the canvas manage_diagram accepts positions in on a blank level (from x = 0)
evidence: Probe maps

rule: Height of the canvas on a blank level (from y = 0)
evidence: Probe maps

rule: Once a level has content the canvas is the content's bounding box plus this fraction of its width and height on each side
evidence: Probe maps and the six exemplar maps
